title: An OpenCode member on podman archives no session export
foundBy: session agent, reading the failed smoke podman legs of ci run 41726614691 on main at 3fb83e6
details:
`TestSmokeReplay/opencode-fireworks` fails on both podman legs, Linux and macOS, with `dev (opencode) archived no session export`. The firecracker leg passes. The replay itself is clean: 49 requests, no miss. The check that fails was added in 4285952. These legs had not run since, because the macOS unit failure in SAC-106 skipped them.

The export loop calls `cs-opencode` by name. The wrapper is at `~/.local/bin/cs-opencode`. Under firecracker the command arrives over ssh and that directory is on PATH. Under podman it is not, so every export fails with `nice: 'cs-opencode': No such file or directory`, and the `|| rm -f` hides the error. Listing the sessions works: a diagnostic run on podman listed both of the member's sessions. The loop called `cs-opencode` by name on OpenCode 1 too, so a podman member has probably never archived an export. `TestOpencodeExportCannotCostTheTarball` could not catch it, because it puts its stub on PATH.
